Paragraph: "Listen to the sound of those mountain streams, Lakshmana! They splash over rocks like laughter echoing through the hills..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hearing the rhythmic, splashing sounds of mountain streams.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama compares the acoustic sound of water to joyful laughter.
Outcome/Resolution: He engages his auditory senses to find lighthearted imagery.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Hasya-Rasa (Subtle joyful/playful sentiment reflected in nature)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The laughing stream reflects the lighthearted, joyous nature underlying divine play (Lila).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Transforming neutral auditory inputs into cheerful metaphors to lighten emotional heaviness.
